name: @lumen/backend-supabase
description: Hosted Supabase bindings for the Lumen Builder: per-domain modules mirroring the local @lumen/app-* packages behind one facade (LumenBackend), plus an offline mode delegating to the local in-memory packages. Zero runtime dependencies — any structurally-compatible Supabase client is accepted via constructor injection (see SupabaseClientLike). Table/column/bucket names follow backend/SCHEMA.md.
